newsitem.title: UK: Copper prices extend gains in LME evening.
newsitem.headline: Copper prices extend gains in LME evening.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) copper prices extended the day's gains during Friday's evening inter-office trade but among other metals only nickel showed any movement.
Traders said that a constructive chart close to the afternoon session had prompted some shortcovering and dealer buying in anticipation of further gains on Monday.
Persistent tightness of nearby dates despite the sharp inflow of metal to LME warehouses during the week was also discouraging to those running short positions.
At 1830 GMT three months delivery copper was quoted at $2,326/$2,331 a tonne compared with a last afternoon trade on the LME floor of $2,316.
Light shortcovering in nickel soon saw sellers back off and the market recovered some its late afternoon losses. It was quoted around $6,800 against an afternoon close of $6,740 a tonne.
